action.command:
ADMIN_TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:8080/realms/master/protocol/openid-connect/token" -d "grant_type=password&client_id=admin-realm&username=admin&password=admin" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['access_token'])") && curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients" | python3 -c "
import sys,json
clients=json.load(sys.stdin)
for c in clients:
    if c['clientId']=='strassennamen':
        print('clientId:', c['clientId'])
        print('enabled:', c['enabled'])
        print('publicClient:', c['publicClient'])
        print('standardFlowEnabled:', c['standardFlowEnabled'])
        print('implicitFlowEnabled:', c['implicitFlowEnabled'])
        print('directAccessGrantsEnabled:', c['directAccessGrantsEnabled'])
        print('serviceAccountsEnabled:', c['serviceAccountsEnabled'])
        print('rootUrl:', c.get('rootUrl'))
        print('baseUrl:', c.get('baseUrl'))
        print('adminUrl:', c.get('adminUrl'))
        print('redirectUris:', c.get('redirectUris'))
        print('webOrigins:', c.get('webOrigins'))
        print('postLogout:', c.get('attributes',{}).get('post.logout.redirect_uris'))
" && echo "=== Client roles ===" && curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients/$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients?clientIds=strassennamen" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]['uuid'])")/roles" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print([r['name'] for r in json.load(sys.stdin)])"
